scope: Versioned lookup integrity only; frozen V1 layout/native codec/metadata validator/limits unchanged.
policy: Every lookup batch verifies catalog bytes and full SHA256/size of every queried shard. Decode/cache rows only after authenticating a bounded immutable bytes snapshot. One shard snapshot at a time, <=35,679,872bytes plus bounded64-block typed cache <=4MiB payload; metadata never substitutes for integrity. Cache continues to save decode work, not full-shard reads. Initial full-format validation is separately retained.
regression: Force unchanged file_stamp for a tampered cached shard: frozen V1 accepts cached data; V2 refuses by checksum. Original real Linux failure and every V1 byte remain unchanged.
deferred: No real-sample lookup/time or native metadata/streaming IO claim. Full per-batch SHA is a correctness tradeoff to evaluate only after validator equivalence and a separate exact sample freeze.
